🎉 Barcelona · Fri 13 Nov
Amon Amarth tonight: the venue's own page says Sant Jordi Club, 19:00; some resellers show other times, so check your ticket.

TODAY · Fri 13 Nov

1. Amon Amarth (support: Orbit Culture, Soilwork)
🕘 Tonight 19:00 · 📍 Sant Jordi Club, Montjuïc
📊 Official Palau Sant Jordi listing, standing tickets on sale
💬 Viking metal headliner on the European tour, a big-sound show for anyone who wants live music before a late night.
https://palausantjordi.barcelona/en/amon-amarth

2. POLENTA
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:30 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 668 interested on RA
💬 Reggaeton night at La Paloma with the biggest club crowd of the night, a party for everyone with lasers and churros.
https://ra.co/events/2554207

3. [Last 100 tickets] Throwback - One More Dance (Back to 80s, 90s & 00s)
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:59 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 645 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €28–600
💬 Open-air 80s, 90s and 00s throwback tardeo, the last edition of the season and nearly sold out.
https://ra.co/events/2565302

4. FRIDAY DJ SESSION PARTY on a ROOFTOP HOTEL (FREE) & FREE CLUB ENTRY
🕘 Tonight 20:00 → 06:00 · 📍 Labtwentytwo Barcelona
📊 156 going on Meetup across 2 listings · group has 49,769 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free rooftop hotel party with free club entry after, the easiest way to meet an international crowd on Friday the 13th.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811206/

5. PRISM pres Colin Benders live & Beste Hira
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 INPUT High Fidelity Dance Club
📊 521 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 €40
💬 Dutch live act Colin Benders plays techno at INPUT, a hi-fi club for people who care about the sound.
https://ra.co/events/2525137

TOMORROW · Sat 14 Nov

1. Bryan Adams - Roll With The Punches tour
🕘 Sat 21:00 · 📍 Palau Sant Jordi
📊 17,960-capacity arena, tickets on sale (venue listing)
💬 Arena rock singalong with the hits, the biggest crowd in the city on Saturday.
https://palausantjordi.barcelona/en/bryan-adams-1

2. SOUNDIT Plaza: Kittin b2b mad miran, Paranoid London live, Spacer, Kudi b2b PEBE
🕘 Sat 16:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 2,256 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 18€, 22€
💬 Afternoon electronic day party in a bullring with Miss Kittin and Paranoid London live, and it ends early enough to go on afterwards.
https://ra.co/events/2480238

3. [LAST 100 TICKETS!] CLOSING PARTY Happy Techno - Open Air La Terrrazza
🕘 Sat 19:00 → 04:00 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 801 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €20
💬 Closing party of the open-air season at La Terrrazza with Matthias Tanzmann, an afternoon-into-night tech house session.
https://ra.co/events/2506339

4. SALSA-BACHATA CLASS 💃 & DJ PARTY + FREE CLUB ENTRY (🎉 WIN 2 BOTTLES OF CAVA)🥂
🕘 Sat 20:30 → 06:00 · 📍 D9 ARIBAU
📊 117 going on Meetup across 3 listings · group has 49,769 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free salsa and bachata class followed by a DJ party and free club entry, easy to join solo and meet people.
https://www.meetup.com/language-exchange-barcelona-meetup/events/316811207/

5. LOST x REECORDS
🕘 Sat 18:30 → 03:00 · 📍 Seaseaclub Barcelona
📊 324 interested on RA · also on DICE, Xceed
💶 €5–8
💬 House and tech house session at a seaside club on the Forum port, cheap tickets and an early start.
https://ra.co/events/2571943

Scanned: Meetup 442 · RA 89 · DICE 33 · Xceed 23 · Eventbrite 180 · Luma 3.
